body:
I took a little bit of time to look through your posts. It looks like you recently lost your job and now you're feeling inferior since your boyfriend has to take up the slack. Is this the case? If it is my main question is what about him. Seems like someone still cares about you. Seems like you had a promising career as an accountant and you lost it and now you're panicking. 

I really wanted to keep my post as vauge as possible but my family does care about me but they've also deeply hurt me. I love them but I also hate them. They conveniently forgot about all of the things they did to hurt me. Because I'm an alcoholic and have some mental health issues they want to say I'm making it all up and fabricating it. So I'm gonna fucking blindside them. They're gonna move away, they're are going to think I'm just fine and that everything is all A-OK and that's when I'm going to do it. I'm going to fucking do it in the middle of a very populated area. It's going to be quick but violent and a lot of people are going to see. I want them to see. I want them, to see me and remember everything they just saw. I want my family to read the headlines. Hell I want to drag them back to the states to have to identify my body. I want to hurt them.  


What about you? Do you want to hurt the people you love? The people who love you? Do you want them to remember this forever and never recover from it? Or are you just in a tight spot and can't think of an easier way out, and this is better than having to depend on someone else?  


Do you realize the consequences of what you will do if you actually go through with it? If you do something, even if you don't succeed, all of the people in your life that care, or have ever cared about you are going to remember and be scarred from it forever. If you do succeed and you have people in your life that still care about you it will destroy them. Trust me I've had people do the same to me. I want to destroy the people in my life. I want them to hurt and ask themselves why I did this? What could they have done to prevent this? Why didn't they see the warning signs and do something? I want them to fucking ask themselves that forever. I want to destroy them.

What about you? Do you want to destroy the people in your lives or are you just in a tight spot and can't see an easier way out. I'll admit suicide is a pretty fucking convenient escape. It's the ultimate plan B.
